verdict.line: You lose if you let Volibear land Q (Thundering Smash) or walk you into Sky Splitter zones for free trades; you win if you dump your E (Facebreaker) stun into a punish the moment his Q is down.

brief.thesis: This is a dead-even lane on the numbers — 50.3% over 2769 games — because both champions are all-in brawlers who win trades by landing one key cooldown: his Q (Thundering Smash) stun or your E (Facebreaker) stun. Whoever's hard engage is up when the fight starts usually wins the exchange, so this matchup is decided by cooldown tracking, not raw stats.

theirWindow.what: He gains speed toward you and the first attack after the gap-close stuns and damages you — do not stand still in his dash lane, and don't let him walk you into a thrown Sky Splitter (E) zone while you're stunned, since OP.GG's own note is to never eat that E in lane.

yourWindow.when: his Q (Thundering Smash) is down (12-10s cooldown by rank)
yourWindow.what: This is your window to initiate. Walk in with Q (Knuckle Down) active for the move speed and the max-health bonus damage on your next two attacks, then land E (Facebreaker) — if he's isolated on one side it only slows, so bait him between your empowered autos to guarantee the pull-stun instead.

start.why: Picked in 76.9% of these games at 50.9% win rate; the lifesteal offsets Volibear's W (Frenzied Maul) sustain in extended trades.

boots.why: 51.3% pick rate at 52.5% win rate; the tenacity shortens how long his Q (Thundering Smash) stun locks you in place for the follow-up Sky Splitter.

core.why: First item in the top build path (61.5% win rate over 491 games); the slow on cast lets you land your E (Facebreaker) stun before he can gap-close with Q.
Pairs with Stridebreaker in the 27.2%-pick path; the armor shred cuts into his tankier late-game health pool.
Shows up across all three top build paths; the bonus health and magic damage proc fights his sustain-heavy brawling.

runes.keystoneWhy: Both listed rune pages (46.5% and 54.1% pick share) run Conqueror — the stacking adaptive force and healing on full stacks keep you even in the extended brawls this matchup forces.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 92% of games at 50.5% win rate — Ignite punishes his W (Frenzied Maul) healing and secures kills once your E (Facebreaker) stun lands.

playing.title: Track his Q cooldown constantly
playing.detail: Thundering Smash is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s by rank — if it's down, he has no stun to open a trade, so this is when you walk up and start one yourself.

playing.title: Never stand still near his E zone
playing.detail: Sky Splitter (16s cooldown, 1200 range) slows and damages anyone in the blast and shields him if he's inside it — OP.GG's own read on this lane is to never get hit by it, so always have an escape angle when he has it up.

playing.title: Bait him off-center for your E stun
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns enemies on opposite sides of you; if he's alone on one side it just slows him. Walk past him mid-trade so he ends up flanked before you cast it.

playing.title: Use Q before every stun window
playing.detail: Knuckle Down's two empowered attacks plus the move speed toward champions should be active before you commit to a stun from E, since the max-health damage is what wins the trade.

playing.title: Hold W until Grit is maxed
playing.detail: Haymaker consumes all stored Grit from damage taken — tank a hit or two from his W (Frenzied Maul) first so your shield and punch damage are worth the 18-12s cooldown.

playing.title: Save R to pull him out of his E zone
playing.detail: The Show Stopper carries him through the air for 400 range, which can drag him out of a thrown Sky Splitter zone or away from his tower — use it reactively, not just as a finisher.

playing.title: Respect level 6 power spike
playing.detail: His Stormbringer leap adds bonus health and disables nearby towers on landing; don't extend trades near your tower once he hits 6 unless your R is also up to answer it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch (16.19.1); the cooldown numbers and ability mechanics are taken directly from the game files, and the tactical reading connecting them — when to trade, what to bait, what to watch — is my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Do not get hit by Volibear’s (E) in lane. Use your skills off cooldown while making sure [W] lands to gain the upper hand.
